build_mask2former_swin_config: build a Mask2Former panoptic segmentation config using Swin-Tiny backbone with LSJ augmentation for COCO dataset
configure_swin_backbone: configure a SwinTransformer backbone with embed_dims 96, depths [2,2,6,2], and window size 7 for feature extraction
set_optimizer_lr_schedules: set custom learning rate multipliers and weight decay for backbone, embeddings, and norm layers in the optimizer
load_pretrained_weights: load pretrained Swin-Tiny weights from GitHub for initializing the backbone network
define_panoptic_head_channels: define Mask2Former panoptic head with multi-scale input channels [96, 192, 384, 768] from Swin backbone stages
